purpose: Immutable built-in sampling presets. IP-5 extends reviewed Default · Balanced family bases into workflow-aware inherited overrides while preserving Provider Defaults and Empty · Clean Slate. IP-6 locks the intent dimension to metadata-only so Realistic / Anime cannot silently fork sampling values.

contract.resolution_key: preset_id + family + variant + loader + mode + intent

presets.label: Provider Defaults
presets.description: Delegate sampling values to the selected provider/compiler. Any stale preset-managed sampling values are removed at the Image job boundary.

presets.label: Empty · Clean Slate
presets.description: Authoring template with no sampling values. Applying it clears preset-managed sampling fields once; later manual values are preserved and must be complete before generation.
